class.name: OcgXcafdocClippingplanetool
class.brief_description: Provide tool for management of ClippingPlane section of document. Provide tool to store, retrieve, remove and modify clipping planes. Each clipping plane consists of gp_Pln and its name.
class.description: ! Provide tool for management of ClippingPlane section of document. ! Provide tool to store, retrieve, remove and modify clipping planes. ! Each clipping plane consists of gp_Pln and its name.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which ClippingPlanes are stored

method.name: IsClippingPlane
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a ClippingPlane table and is a ClippingPlane definition

method.name: GetClippingPlane_2
method.description: Returns ClippingPlane defined by label lab Returns False if the label is not in ClippingPlane table or does not define a ClippingPlane

method.name: AddClippingPlane_3
method.description: Adds a clipping plane definition to a ClippingPlane table and returns its label (returns existing label if the same clipping plane is already defined)

method.name: AddClippingPlane_4
method.description: Adds a clipping plane definition to a ClippingPlane table and returns its label (returns existing label if the same clipping plane is already defined)

method.name: AddClippingPlane_1
method.description: Adds a clipping plane definition to a ClippingPlane table and returns its label (returns existing label if the same clipping plane is already defined)

method.name: AddClippingPlane_2
method.description: Adds a clipping plane definition to a ClippingPlane table and returns its label (returns existing label if the same clipping plane is already defined)

method.name: RemoveClippingPlane
method.description: Removes clipping plane from the ClippingPlane table Return false and do nothing if clipping plane is referenced in at least one View

method.name: GetClippingPlanes
method.description: Returns a sequence of clipping planes currently stored in the ClippingPlane table

method.name: UpdateClippingPlane
method.description: Sets new value of plane and name to the given clipping plane label or do nothing, if the given label is not a clipping plane label

method.name: SetCapping
method.description: Set new value of capping for given clipping plane label

method.name: GetCapping_1
method.description: Get capping value for given clipping plane label Return capping value

method.name: GetCapping_2
method.description: Get capping value for given clipping plane label Return true if Label is valid and capping exists.
